title: Small Wins Runtime Roundtable — prep & action tracker
content:
Purpose: quick weekly touch to highlight small wins, unblock cross-cutting infra/console/runtime items, and capture 1–2 focused action items per sub-area. Tone = short, outcomes-first.

Meeting logistics (30m total)
- When: weekly, Tues 10:00–10:30 PT (timebox strictly to 30m).
- Attendees: runtime leads, infra on-call rep, console PM/engineer, SRE bridge, plus rotating owner (this week: Simon).
- Pre-reads: short metrics snapshot (bring p50/p95 token latencies, queue depth, GPU util, top-5 error classes).

Proposed run of show (strict):
- 00:00–02:00 (2m) — Quick opener: wins and one headline (owner: Simon)
- 02:00–12:00 (10m) — Signals + triage (metrics + incidents): Leila to surface top anomalies
- 12:00–22:00 (10m) — Surface 3 focused blockers (runtime, infra, console) with concrete asks
- 22:00–28:00 (6m) — Commit action items and owners (1–2 per area max)
- 28:00–30:00 (2m) — Parking lot + quick sync on next owner/rotations

Pre-meeting checklist (Simon):
- Grab latest metrics snapshot from dashboard (link above) and paste top 3 bullet takeaways into Slack #runtime-sync by 09:40.
- Confirm rotating owner for next week and ping them to prepare 1 highlight.
- Pull any open PRs that are blocking rollout (filter: label:blocking-rollout).

Signals to bring (short bullets we can read aloud):
- Latency: p50 = 38ms (steady), p95 = 220ms (spike Tues morning due to long-context requests)
- Throughput: sustained QPS 22k, capacity headroom ~12% on us-west pools
- Queue/backlog: avg queue depth = 14 requests during peak; tail correlated with model-quantized fallback events
- Errors: transient 503s tied to autoscaler race (see JIRA-ENG-4821)

Focused block items (what to discuss, what to decide)
1) Runtime: KV cache wrap-around causing small spike in p95 for long-session chat.
   - What I want: agreement on short-term mitigation (force cache hot-path off for long sessions) + owner to land change.
   - Proposal: Diego to cut a small runtime patch that disables prefix caching for sessions > 8k tokens (monitor for cost impact).
   - Risk/questions: perf regression for common cases? fallback plan = quick rollback via feature flag.

2) Infra: autoscaler race under bursty spikes (recent 503s).
   - What I want: confirm hotfix plan + rollout window.
   - Current plan: bump grace timer + add instrumentation to detect double-provision path.
   - Owner: Meera to coordinate with SRE to schedule hotfix during low-traffic window Thu 02:00–04:00 PT.

3) Console: rollout UI change to surface model fallback reason to customers (helps support).
   - What I want: agreement on message copy + telemetry events to add.
   - Owner: Leila to propose copy in PR and small telemetry spec; target EOD Fri.

Open questions / parking lot (to move to backlog or follow-up):
- Do we want an experiment to route long-context traffic to a specialized pool? (cost trade-off, capture telemetry first).
- Investigate whether quantized fallback is more frequent for certain model families — propose a weekly small eval job.

Action-item tracker (committed during meeting)
- Diego Ramos | runtime patch to disable prefix caching for sessions >8k tokens | due 2026-03-16 | status: in_progress | linked: github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/2120
- Meera Narayan | schedule infra hotfix and coordinate SRE runbook update | due 2026-03-18 | status: todo | linked: JIRA-ENG-4821
- Leila Kim | console copy + telemetry PR for fallback message | due 2026-03-13 | status: in_review | linked: confluence/internal/console-fallback-ux
- Simon Choi | publish meeting notes + short metrics snippet to #runtime-sync | due 2026-03-13 | status: todo | linked: slack.com/channel/runtime-sync

Quick retrospective notes (2 min at end):
- Do we keep 30m cadence? Quick poll: keep, reduce to 20m, or biweekly? (Simon to run poll in Slack).
- Value check: did each attendee get at least one concrete next step? If not, adjust format next week.

Prep notes for next owner (template to reuse):
- Paste top-3 signals as bullets.
- Bring 0–1 demo or screenshot if discussing console UX.
- Limit blockers to no more than 3 and include suggested mitigations (not just problems).

Notes-to-self (Simon):
- Keep people timeboxed; call out when we slip over 12 mins on signals.
- Make the action items visible in meeting thread right away and tag owners.
- Follow up on PR comment from Diego re: perf regression test coverage.

End of scratchpad.

(Version history: initial draft 2026-03-10; refined with metrics + owners 2026-03-13)
